description: Open a pick session for faces, edges, or sketch entities.

keep.description: Keep picks already there. Default: false for the selection, true for a card (its preselection or stored edges).

kind.description: face or edge for the viewport selection; point, line, arc, or ref for an open contour gesture or hole-centres sketch.

params.description: Card fields: fillet radius, chamfer chamfer, shell wall/openingMode, draft angle/flip, moveFace distance/flip.

replace.description: End a live session instead of failing with pick_open.

timeout_ms.description: Idle time before the session expires. Default 120000.

tool.description: Open this picker card, the same as its rail button. Omit to feed the open card or the selection.

name: pick_begin
